data.name: Soulstonia
data.detailed_description:
Play Your Way

Welcome to Soulstonia, a cozy fantasy RPG where your adventurers don't stand around waiting for you.

Recruit Summoners with their own skills, equipment, traits, dreams, and ambitions. Send them gathering, crafting, fighting, or exploring, or leave them to decide what to work on themselves.

See something interesting? Take direct control at any time.

Guide one Summoner personally. Bring everyone together as a party. Or sit back and watch your little band of adventurers make progress without you.

Play hands-on. Play idle. Switch whenever you want.

Minds of Their Own

Every Summoner grows independently, giving you a party to shape rather than a single character to level.

Train 20+ combat, collection, and crafting skills as you build specialists, generalists, or whatever strange combination your adventure produces.

Mine ore and turn it into equipment. Chop trees and build useful structures. Catch fish and cook meals. Farm crops, steal from markets, carve magical runes, enchant equipment, cast spells, and fight increasingly dangerous enemies.

Almost everything feeds into something else, and almost everything makes somebody better at what they do.

You can chase the next unlock yourself, or let your Summoners chase it for you.

Summon Your Army

Enemies don't always have to stay enemies.

Discover magical Soulstones that allow your Summoners to call creatures into the world and make them part of the party.

Send your summons into battle alongside you, experiment with different combinations of creatures and Summoners, and discover creatures capable of helping harvest resources while your party works.

Build around skills, equipment, traits, spells, enchantments, and summons to create a party that plays the way you want.

A Living World

Every adventure unfolds across a procedurally generated fantasy continent divided into distinct regions with their own landscapes, resources, characters, cultures, languages, and conflicts.

Push back the fog of war and discover villages, quarries, rune altars, ruins, prisons, strongholds, hidden treasures, colossal enemies, and strange encounters scattered throughout the world.

Soulstonia doesn't simply wait for you.

Invaders can arrive on distant shores. Diseases can spread through your party. Markets can rise and crash. Wildfires can tear through forests. Blood moons can empower the creatures lurking outside.

Explore. Quest. Build. Fight. Gather. Experiment. Or forget what you were doing and spend the afternoon fishing.

Your cozy adventure awaits...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 Dual-Core
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 Quad-Core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 1060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 14.0 Sonoma
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (64-bit)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated graphics or Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 14.0 Sonoma
  • Processor: Apple M2 or Intel Core i7 Quad-Core
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 integrated graphics or AMD Radeon Pro 560X equivalent
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Core Audio compatible
  • Additional Notes: Apple Silicon recommended
